Towards the end we will unite our voices in toning and mantra. We will have some slow time at the end to process. This is a great opportunity to rest, relax, come back to yourself, and meditate on the nature of sound and silence.

Sound healing, alongside silent meditation, is one of humanity’s oldest practices to restore balance to body, mind and spirit. rows.title: J Chong Dinner at Zelda Dearest
rows.summary: Chef J Chong takes over the kitchen for a one night prix fixe dinner in Zelda Dearest’s polished dining room. Expect coursed plates with tightly paced service and a special menu built around seasonal ingredients.
rows.description: A Warm Invitation to an Intimate Evening of Cantonese Cuisine & Wine Join us at Zelda Dearest for a truly special night with Chef J Chong, as we gather around the table for an unforgettable wine dinner experience filled with heart, heritage, and hospitality. Indulge in a thoughtfully curated four-course Cantonese menu, each dish artfully paired with exceptional selections from Rise Over Run. This exclusive dinner series celebrates bold flavors, refined technique, and harmonious pairings — where Cantonese tradition meets contemporary elegance in every bite and every sip. rows.title: J Chong Dinner Series at Zelda Dearest
rows.summary: Bold Cantonese flavors paired with minimal intervention wines in an intimate multi course, chef led dinner that blends heartfelt storytelling and curated bottles from a women owned importer; limited seating encourages connection.
rows.description: An intimate Cantonese dining experience with Asheville’s J Chong—flavor, storytelling, and connection in every bite. Limited seats! Join us for an evening celebrating two Asheville visionairies shaping how we eat , drink, and connect. This wine dinner at Zelda Dearest brings together Chef J Chong, beloved for her bold, heartfelt approach to Cantonese cuisine, and Rise Over Run, a women-owned wine importer and distributor devoted to minimal-intervention producers and stories told through the land itself.

rows.title: Rejuvenating Waterfalls Yoga Micro Retreat
rows.summary: A half-day micro retreat blending guided yoga with a rejuvenating waterfall hike and quiet nature immersion near Zirconia. Expect fresh mountain air, grounding movement, and a reset-focused outdoor wellness escape.

rows.title: Epic Themed Scavenger Hunt Adventure in Asheville by Wacky Walks
rows.organizer: Zombie Scavengers - Zombie Survival Scavenger Hunt
rows.summary: App driven urban scavenger hunt dispatches teams on zombie themed missions and item finding challenges across Asheville streets. Players solve clues in the scavenger hunt app, exploring landmarks and competing in lively team play.
rows.description: Join us for a fun Wacky Walk scavenger hunt! Find items & complete missions in our scavenger hunt app and explore the city.

rows.title: 'Reconnect for Better Days' Monthly Webinar
rows.summary: One-hour monthly Zoom sessions delivering simple, trauma-informed resilience tools and community healing practices for WNC residents, scheduled first Fridays at noon; free registration provides a supportive space for better days.
rows.description: In the year following Helene, we continue to hold space for WNC residents to find community healing and connection. This FREE monthly presentation from Resources for Resilience™ offers simple but powerful strategies to help us feel better and experience better days. • EXPLORE why and how our brains and bodies react to stress. • LEARN how to identify problems as they arise • PRACTICE tools that help us move forward in the moment. This event will be held on the FIRST FRIDAY of every month from 12-1pm, from now through November 21. Sign up here to receive a Zoom invite: https://bit.ly/RBD-WNC
